integrity: All derivations, limits and definitions are supplied in RESULT.md and an independent finite exact-arithmetic checker is included. No independent review or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite connected unweighted complete bipartite graphs with the unnormalized combinatorial Laplacian.
Graph edge variation is the sum of absolute real cross-edge differences, not a normalized or Euclidean norm.
A sharp singleton witness is exhibited but all extremizers are not classified.
An equivalent implicit formula in older literature remains possible; bibliographic priority is not certified.
title: Sharp edge-variation heat amplification on complete bipartite graphs
